title: Saved report columns and sort reset once on release day
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a browser in which you changed the columns and the sort of Sales By Representative before the release was installed.
  • With the release installed, open Reports > Sales By Representative in that browser, at a desktop width of at least 1024 pixels.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the columns and the sort.
  2. Turn a column on or off in the column selector.
  3. Change the sort.
  4. Leave the report for another page.
  5. Open Reports > Sales By Representative again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The columns and the sort are back to the defaults.
  • The Sales Type column is off.

Step 2:

  • The report shows your column change.

Step 3:

  • The report shows your sort.

Step 4:

  • The other page opens.

Step 5:

  • Your new choices are kept.
  • The reset happened only once.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • Release day: “Each user's saved column choices and sort on Sales By Representative reset once to the defaults.”
  • S5-R21: “The Sales Type column is off by default on screen, for every user.”
